description_zh: 调用DescribeRDSPerformance接口查询存储层RDS性能数据详情
name: DescribeRDSPerformance

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">Instance ID of the PolarDB-X instance.</props>

parameters.help_en:
The performance monitoring metrics. You can specify multiple metrics in a single request. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,).
For more information about performance monitoring metrics, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186705.html

性能监控指标，允许一次传入多个指标进行查询，多个指标参数间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
更多关于性能监控指标详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186705.html
